BAJFINANCE.attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5,74,25,740 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on November 10, 2026
BAJFINANCE.voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The allotment was approved by the PI 2026 Allotment Committee on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is priced at Rs. 1,010 and is convertible into one equity share of face value Re. 1. The warrants are convertible into equity shares pari passu with existing fully paid-up shares. Upon issuance, a minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable on the date of allotment. The remaining 75 percent is payable when the options against the warrants are exercised. If the allottee does not exercise the option within eighteen months from the date of allotment, the consideration amount shall be forfeited by the company.

BAJFINANCE.attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of PI 2026 - Special Committee Meeting held on November 10, 2026.
BAJFINANCE.voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved a preferential issue of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The approval was granted by the Special Committee of the Board of Directors during its meeting on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is issued at a price of Rs. 1,010. The total aggregation of the issue amounts to Rs. 57,99,99,97,400. These warrants are convertible into equivalent equity shares with a face value of Rs. 1 each. The transaction follows the provisions of Chapter V of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 2018. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company has informed the BSE and NSE regarding this corporate action.

MARUTI.attchmntText: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Reference to the Financial Results issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation
MARUTI.voiceSummary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited filed a reference to the Financial Results for the first six months of FY 2026 issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation in Japan on 10th November 2026. Suzuki Motor Corporation reported consolidated revenue of 1,466.5 billion yen for the period, an increase of 16.8 percent year-on-year. Operating profit was 134.3 billion yen, a decrease of 0.6 percent. Profit before tax stood at 156.5 billion yen, down 24.5 percent. Profit attributable to owners of parent was 90.8 billion yen, a decline of 22.8 percent. The company noted increased revenue but decreased profit. Foreign exchange rates and raw material prices were cited as external factors affecting results. Capital expenditures were 87.3 billion yen. Interest-bearing debt balance was 736.0 billion yen. Cash balance was 930.0 billion yen. The filing was submitted by Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary.

The impact on the financial, operational, or other activities of the listed entity is quantified only to the extent of the penalty amount. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Para A Sub Para 20 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

RADICO.attchmntText: Radico Khaitan Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
RADICO.voiceSummary: Radico Khaitan Limited disclosed that the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence issued seizure memos under Section 110 of the Customs Act, 1962, on November 06, 2026. The action concerns goods valued at approximately INR 2.64 crore. The matter relates to the customs tariff classification of imported goods and preferential tariff treatment under the India-United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement. The company stated that the delay in reporting was unintentional due to Diwali holidays. Radico Khaitan is engaging with authorities to seek the release of the goods. The company confirmed that operations are continuing in the normal course and reported no material impact or disruption to business as of the date of the announcement.

MRF.attchmntText: MRF Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Press Release ".
MRF.voiceSummary: MRF Limited held a Board Meeting on 10th November, 2026, to consider Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Consolidated total income was Rs 8791.58 Crores, compared to Rs 7489.00 Crores in the corresponding quarter of 2025. Consolidated profit before tax stood at Rs 521.81 Crores, down from Rs 700.45 Crores. After a tax provision of Rs 134.82 Crores, consolidated net profit was Rs 386.99 Crores, compared to Rs 527.43 Crores previously. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share for the financial year ending 31st March, 2027. The company noted strong sales growth but highlighted adverse impacts from rising raw material prices.

DABUR.attchmntText: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Analyst/ Institutional Investor Meet held on November 05, 2026.
DABUR.voiceSummary: Dabur India Limited filed the transcript of its Analyst and Institutional Investor Meet held on November 5, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The meeting featured Herjit Bhalla, Chief Executive Officer India Business, and Ankush Jain, Chief Financial Officer. Bhalla outlined his assessment of the business after six months, highlighting the company's heritage and market leadership. He emphasized four key focus areas: enhancing brand spending, leading in health and wellness, transforming the portfolio, and improving execution quality. The management discussed accelerating core brands, including new campaigns for Chyawanprash and Odonil. Digital media spend now constitutes approximately 43% of total spend. The company noted challenges from elevated inflation and crude prices but remains focused on cost optimization and calibrated price increases. The transcript is available on the company website at www.dabur.com.

EXIDEIND.attchmntText: Exide Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
EXIDEIND.voiceSummary: Exide Industries Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call with the Calcutta Stock Exchange, BSE Limited, and NSE on 10th November 2026. The company reported standalone revenue of INR5,026 crores, up 20.3% year-on-year, and EBITDA of INR606 crores, up 53.6% year-on-year. EBITDA margin improved to 12.1% from 9.4% in the previous year. Half-yearly revenue reached INR10,331 crores, up 18.9% year-on-year. The company remains debt-free. Management highlighted commissioning of a 6 GWh lithium-ion cell plant in Bengaluru on 23rd September. Cumulative equity investment in Exide Energy Solutions Limited stands at INR5,352 crores. Automotive OEM business grew over 25%, while solar business grew over 40%. Exports grew over 20% year-on-year.

LALPATHLAB.attchmntText: Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd. has informed the Exchange about Transcript
LALPATHLAB.voiceSummary: Dr. Lal PathLabs Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs. 874 crore, reflecting 19.6% growth. First half FY27 revenue stood at Rs. 1,672 crore, marking 19.4% growth. Q2 FY27 EBITDA was Rs. 280 crore with a margin of 32.1%. First half FY27 EBITDA was Rs. 528 crore with a margin of 31.6%. Q2 FY27 PAT was Rs. 194 crore, showing 27.5% growth. First half FY27 PAT was Rs. 364 crore, showing 27.3% growth. Earnings per share for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 11.5. The Board declared a second interim dividend of Rs. 5 per share. The company completed the acquisition of SN GeneLab Private Limited and acquired the remaining 30% stake in Centrapath Labs. Net cash as of 30th September 2026 was Rs. 1,746 crore.

CONCOR.attchmntText: Container Corporation Of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
CONCOR.voiceSummary: Container Corporation of India Limited released the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 03.11.2026. The company reported highest ever physical performance with total handling volume of 1,448,379 TEUs. Operating turnover reached INR2,373 crores and total income was INR2,466 crores. Standalone profit before tax was INR462 crores. The company announced a dividend of INR1.9 per share. Total dividend for the first half is INR3.5 per share. EBITDA margin stood at 25.79%. Capex for the quarter was INR299.75 crores. Total half year capex increased to INR418.05 crores. Management cited geopolitical turbulence in the Gulf as a challenge. However, domestic and EXIM segments showed resilience. Nepal business volume increased by 138%. Bulk cement tank container volume reported about 12,000 TEUs. Management stated they would review guidance in December.

The auditor’s report highlights suspension of construction for two passenger vessels with bank guarantees of Rs. 112,412 lakhs pending renewal. Hooghly Cochin Shipyard Limited faces lease accounting discrepancies and a Rs. 55 lakh provision for delayed lease rent interest. NBCC.attchmntText: NBCC (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
NBCC.voiceSummary: NBCC India Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was INR 2,890 crores, a 38% year-on-year increase. Standalone EBITDA rose 154% to INR 219 crores, and PAT increased 31% to INR 225 crores. The standalone order book stands at INR 1,12,000 crores, with a consolidated order book of INR 1,26,000 crores. New business secured in Q2 was INR 3,600 crores on a consolidated basis. The company sold residential apartments worth INR 5,191 crores under the 7 GPRA project. HUDCO.voiceSummary: Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 6th November 2026. During the first half of FY27, loan disbursements exceeded INR35,000 crores, a 37% increase year-on-year. Loan sanctions surpassed INR1 lakh crore. The loan book grew 29% to INR1.86 lakh crores. Revenue from operations rose 26%. Net profit increased 31%. Gross NPA declined to 0.7%. Net NPA stood at 0.04%. The blended cost of funds is 7.07%. The company targets a loan book of INR2 lakh crores for the current financial year. Management aims to maintain spreads at 2% and net interest margins at 3%.

Acquisitions including Core, DAPIC, and Scientific are performing well. North India revenue contribution is approximately 17%. The transcript is available on the company website.

PRICOLLTD.attchmntText: Pricol Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
PRICOLLTD.voiceSummary: Pricol Limited submitted the transcript of its earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call was held on 5th November 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 was Rs. 1334.02 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.82%. Profit after tax was Rs. 85.21 crores. For H1 FY2027, revenue was Rs. 2417.60 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.64%. PAT margin was 6.30% with EPS at 12.49. Q2 revenue grew 35.03% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 27.87% year-on-year. Management cited rising input costs due to dollar appreciation, bare PCB costs, and memory costs as headwinds. These factors are expected to continue for several quarters. Cost pass-through discussions with customers are ongoing.

SJS.attchmntText: S.J.S. Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
SJS.voiceSummary: SJS Enterprises Limited filed transcripts of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings conference call with the NSE and BSE. The call was held on November 05, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the quarter rose 16.9% year-on-year to Rs. 2,827.3 million. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 583.3 million, with a margin of 20.6%. H1 FY2027 revenue grew 20.4% to Rs. 5,437.3 million. The company acquired the remaining 9.9% stake in Walter Pack India for Rs. 199.22 million. Net cash at the end of September 2026 was Rs. 3,318.7 million. The new chrome plating facility in Pune commenced operations in August 2026. The Bangalore plant expansion is complete. SJS Display Electronics Private Limited is setting up an automotive display facility in Pune, expected to be operational in Q2 FY2028.

VTL.attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript.
VTL.voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE on 10th November 2026. The call was held on 6th November 2026. Management reported improved yarn business performance driven by higher demand, rising yarn prices, and trading gains from low-cost cotton purchases. Current cotton landed costs are approximately INR65,000 per candy. The fabric business faced challenges due to lower export volumes, tariff uncertainty, and higher input costs. The company expects improved order pipelines following US election results. An open-end yarn project with a capacity of 50 tons per day is expected to be operational in six to seven months. No major capital expenditure plans for the spinning business have been announced for the next two years.

NCC.attchmntText: NCC Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
NCC.voiceSummary: NCC Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 6, 2026, to the NSE and BSE. The company reported consolidated turnover of INR6,042 crores for the quarter, a 32 percent increase from the previous year. Standalone turnover was INR4,957 crores, up 31 percent. Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 8.8 percent. The order book as of September 30, 2026, was INR80,167 crores, with new orders of INR4,838 crores booked during the quarter. The company retained its FY27 guidance, targeting order inflow between INR22,000 crores and INR25,000 crores, revenue growth of 8 to 10 percent, and an EBITDA margin of 8.5 to 9 percent. Debt-equity ratio was 0.32 at the end of the quarter.

Capex for FY 2026-27 is estimated between Rs. 1,200 crore and Rs. 1,500 crore. No unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the call.
